_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "organizations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "tr_registration_no" TEXT NULL, "tr_aks_no" TEXT NULL, "hive_count_range" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memberships" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apiaries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "altitude_m" INTEGER NULL, "landowner_name" TEXT NULL, "landowner_phone" TEXT NULL, "land_tenure" TEXT NULL, "water_source" TEXT NULL, "vehicle_distance_m" INTEGER NULL, "road_notes" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((latitude IS NULL) = (longitude IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "mark_color" TEXT NULL, "breed" TEXT NULL, "breed_line" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "mating_status" TEXT NULL, "wing_clipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("wing_clipped" IN (0, 1)), "mother_queen_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hives" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_code" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "queen_id" TEXT NULL, "box_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "frame_count" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "marking" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hive_location_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "moved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "queen_state" TEXT NULL, "bee_frames" INTEGER NULL, "brood_frames" INTEGER NULL, "honey_frames" INTEGER NULL, "temperament" TEXT NULL, "swarm_signs" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("swarm_signs" IN (0, 1)), "queen_cells" TEXT NULL, "disease_suspected" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("disease_suspected" IN (0, 1)), "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspection_drafts" ("hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "draft" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("hive_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspection_id" TEXT NULL, "treatment_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "captured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_uploads" ("media_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("media_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mite_counts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "counted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "mites" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sample_bees" INTEGER NULL, "days" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ref_drugs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "country_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_tr" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_ingredient" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "withdrawal_days" INTEGER NULL, "license_no" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drugs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_ingredient" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "withdrawal_days" INTEGER NULL, "license_no" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "treatments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_drug_id" TEXT NULL, "drug_id" TEXT NULL, "application_id" TEXT NULL, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_ingredient" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_no" TEXT NULL, "dose" REAL NOT NULL, "dose_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_removal_at" TEXT NULL, "withdrawal_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feedings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "feeding_group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NULL, "assigned_to" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "source_step" INTEGER NULL, "ref_drug_id" TEXT NULL, "drug_id" TEXT NULL, "dose" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "harvests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvested_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "honey_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_kg" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "harvest_hives" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvest_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "withdrawal_treatment_id" TEXT NULL, "withdrawal_override_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_type_name" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "expires_on" TEXT NULL, "file_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_uploads" ("storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("storage_path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migrations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_stops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "migration_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "planned_start_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_end_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NULL, "hive_count" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "migration_stop_id" TEXT NULL, "source_apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination_apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transport_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transport_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle" TEXT NOT NULL, "loaded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "unloaded_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "threshold" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_moves" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "moved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "linked_table" TEXT NULL, "linked_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queen_rearing_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mother_queen_id" TEXT NULL, "grafted_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "grafted_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "accepted_count" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mating_nucs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rearing_batch_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "queen_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "honey_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NULL, "moisture" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "published" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("published" IN (0, 1)), "public_producer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("public_producer" IN (0, 1)), "public_origin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("public_origin" IN (0, 1)), "public_lab" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("public_lab" IN (0, 1)), "public_report" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("public_report" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lot_harvests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvest_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lot_treatments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvest_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "treatment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "treated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "withdrawal_ends_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "withdrawal_violation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("withdrawal_violation" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lab_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tested_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "hmf" REAL NULL, "diastase" REAL NULL, "proline" REAL NULL, "moisture" REAL NULL, "residue" TEXT NULL, "document_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lot_sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sold_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "kg" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "receipt_path" TEXT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NULL, "transport_id" TEXT NULL, "lot_sale_id" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_uploads" ("storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("storage_path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "paid_on" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feedback_queue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "screenshot_file_name" TEXT NULL, "device_info" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "failed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("failed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "analytics_queue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "props" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "record_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("record_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pulled_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("record_table"));
